briefdescription.para: Computes the best rational approximation of n/d with a bounded denominator.

detaileddescription.para: Uses a continued-fraction expansion with semiconvergents. If n/d is exactly representable with a denominator <= max_den, the reduced fraction is returned.

parameterdescription.para: Maximum allowed denominator of the result.
Denominator of the approximation (1 <= out_d <= max_den).

briefdescription.para: Encodes a fractional divider N = num/den into the 15-bit register triple.

detaileddescription.para: Formula verified against the ID_TEST reference export (no -512 offset, as stated in the Si5332 reference manual): INTG=floor(128*num/den) RES=(128*num)modden DEN=den

briefdescription.para: Plans a fresh (currently unused) MultiSynth divider for frequency f.

detaileddescription.para: Selects the smallest R divider for which the resulting N = VCO_HZ / (f*R) fits into the 15-bit fractional divider (#ID_N_MIN <= N < 256), then approximates N with rational_approx() using a denominator up to ID_DEN_MAX.
